world: a frozen snow kingdom with ancient stone ruins and mythical beasts
characters: Kael: 19-year-old male scout, athletic build, messy dark hair, piercing blue eyes, wearing a rugged wolf-pelt parka, leather bracers, and carrying a carved bone bow. Lyra: 17-year-old female scholar, silver-blonde braided hair, copper goggles resting on forehead, wearing a thick teal fur-lined coat with an antique glowing brass compass. Frostgale: Colossal mythical six-legged snow feline beast covered in thick white fur, with glowing crystalline antlers and luminous cyan eyes.
title: Part 1: The Sky Shatters
summary: Siblings Kael and Lyra investigate the sudden shattering of the sun and discover ancient ruins holding a legendary six-legged frost beast. When a sinister black frost attacks, the temple floor collapses, plunging the siblings and the mythical creature into a hidden subterranean kingdom.

world: towering mountains where a lone warrior protects a village from a giant beast
characters: Kaelen: 28-year-old lone warrior, athletic build, rugged black hair in a short warrior knot, faint scar over nose bridge, wearing dark gray fur-lined leather armor, faded turquoise scarf, wielding an obsidian broadsword. Mila: 10-year-old girl, big amber eyes, curly brown hair under a dark sheepskin hood, wearing a woolen tunic, clutching a glowing silver bell necklace. Gorgarok: 40-foot mountain titan beast, jagged crystalline horn crown, rocky obsidian hide encrusted with ice, four glowing cerulean eyes, exhaling icy vapor.
title: Part 1: The Mountain Awakes
summary: Lone warrior Kaelen prepares to defend his mountain home when Gorgarok the colossal mountain titan attacks the cliffs. But Kaelen discovers a shocking secret: the beast is grieving a stolen child, and Mila's glowing bell holds the key.
